summary: Careful, well-documented preregistered paired study comparing a RAG+deterministic-verifier pipeline to LLM-only on 200 intent→configuration tasks. Strong reproducibility effort (extensive artifacts/hashes). However, there are critical internal inconsistencies in reported contingency counts/definitions and insufficient reporting on retrieval-corpus provenance, repair logic, and leakage-flag summary. The preregistered primary hypothesis was not supported; conclusions must be tightened and a set of mandatory corrections supplied before finalisation.
critical_issues: Inconsistent contingency counts and discordant-labeling: reported marginal success counts (baseline_success=199, guarded_success=200) contradict the contingency cell counts (n11=199, n10=1, n01=0, n00=0) and the stated discordant ordering. The document mixes definitions of n10/n01 (baseline vs guarded mapping) — this undermines the primary analysis.

Analytical inconsistency: with one discordant pair where guarded succeeds and baseline fails, the contingency should reflect n01=1 (not n10=1). The McNemar p-value (reported 1.0) and reported discordant counts are therefore inconsistent and must be recomputed after fixing labels.

Provider-call / stage-count ambiguity: provider_call_audit and stage_counts report surprising values (e.g., condition_counts {"shared":200,"guarded":1}) that conflict with completed_episode_count=400 and the paired design. This mismatch must be resolved and explained.

Ceiling effect and power mismatch: preregistered target (≥30% relative reduction) was unrealistic given the observed near-perfect baseline; the manuscript inadequately addresses how the ceiling effect affects interpretability and statistical power (a planned post-hoc detectable-effect analysis is referenced but not shown).

Retrieval-corpus provenance and leakage handling underreported: while contamination-detection artifacts are listed, the manuscript omits a concise summary of how many tasks were flagged for exact-match or high-similarity leakage and how those sensitivity analyses change primary conclusions.

Repair-loop details absent: the guarded pipeline executed only a single automated repair for one task (repair_count=1); manuscript must describe the repair algorithm, decision rules, why repair was rarely invoked, and implications for evaluating a generate→verify→repair architecture.

Definitions and mapping of success/failure are underspecified: what exact verifier outputs constitute the binary "critical error" vs "success" (stringent pass/fail rules, normalization steps, handling of equivalent-but-different configurations) must be precisely defined and linked to scoring JSONs.

Accessibility of archived artifacts: many hashed artifacts are listed, but public access URLs or a clear retrieval mechanism for the replication package are not provided in the manuscript; reproducibility claims require accessible links or instructions.
Overclaim risk: statements implying operational implications are not sufficiently qualified given single-model, sandboxed setting and unresolved contamination uncertainty.
required_revisions: Resolve and correct all internal accounting inconsistencies: (a) reconcile marginal counts and contingency table cell labeling (explicitly define n11,n10,n01,n00 and mapping to baseline/guarded), (b) recompute McNemar exact p-value and bootstrap CI after correction, and (c) update all reported numeric results, figures, tables, and downstream interpretations accordingly. Provide a short deterministic reconciliation appendix (with hashes) showing corrected counts.

Clarify provider-call and stage_count reporting: explain condition_counts and stage_counts entries and verify they align with completed_episode_count and call traces; if any logging/tracking bug occurred, report the deviation and corrected logs.

Include a concise leakage/contamination summary in the main paper (counts and effect): report how many tasks triggered exact-match or high-similarity flags, and include the results of the pre-specified sensitivity analyses that exclude flagged tasks (primary estimand recomputed on exclusive set).

Fully specify the guarded repair logic in the Methods: give algorithmic pseudocode, decision thresholds, when a repair is triggered, and why only one repair occurred; link to the exact repair code file path and hash in the execution_manifest.

Provide the exact prompts used (baseline and guarded) and retrieval-index seeds/queries in the manuscript or a short appendix within the five-page limit (or an immutable persistent reference), and point to the archival path/URLs for raw per-task prompts and model responses.

Add the planned post-hoc power/sensitivity analysis given the observed baseline rate (as promised in preregistration): compute detectable absolute and relative effect sizes with N=200 and report implications for interpretation.
Correct wording that could be read as generalizing beyond scope: explicitly limit operational conclusions and remove any language implying production-readiness.

Ensure artifact accessibility: include URLs or instructions (and required credentials if any) enabling reviewers to retrieve the execution_manifest, scoring JSONs, and per-task scoring files referenced by hash. If artifacts are not public, state access conditions and provide a reproducibility contact.

Fix minor reporting inconsistencies (e.g., description of primary/secondary endpoints, which secondary analyses were actually executed vs only planned) and ensure all preregistration deviations (if any) are listed; if none, state that explicitly.
optional_revisions: Expand discussion of ceiling effect and how task construction could be diversified in future work (more adversarial or low-resource tasks).

Run and report the pre-specified subgroup (per-topology-family) summaries and BH-adjusted secondary tests in the manuscript (concise table) or include key numbers in an appendix, to support exploratory EQ1 findings.

If possible, add one or two additional LLM variants (or at least a held-out alternate model on a small validation subset) to support generalizability claims (EQ2) — if infeasible, state resource constraints candidly.
Report latency/operational-cost trade-offs with summary statistics (median, IQR) since H3 was pre-specified; even if non-confirmatory, include results or explicit omission reason.
Include a one-paragraph reproducibility checklist mapping each claimed artifact to a concrete file path/URL and hash for fast verification by reviewers.
